title: Oracle host dispatch simulation
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean oracle Turing machine and let $C$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine with at least one work tape; choose states $en$ and $ex$ of $C$, and fix a Boolean input word $x$. Consider two configurations $c,c'$ of the four-tape dispatch machine on $x$, and let $T$ be a natural number. If the dispatch machine run from $c$ for $T$ steps is $c'$, the state of $c'$ is $s'$, the host construction redirects dispatch state $s'$ to phase state $q'$, and every state occurring in the dispatch run at a time $u<T$ is internal (that is, neither ready, copy, nor an answer state), then the host machine run for $T+1$ steps from the phase-tagged embedding of $c$ reaches the phase-tagged embedding of $c'$, with its state replaced by the constant phase state $q'$. This holds for every choice of host-tape contents and head positions used in those embeddings.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean oracle Turing machine
$C$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$C$ has at least one work tape
host-tape contents and head positions are specified
$c$ and $c'$ are four-tape dispatch configurations on $x$
the dispatch run from $c$ for $T$ steps equals $c'$
every state at each time $u<T$ is internal, meaning neither ready, copy, nor an answer state
